items.title: Ruth Lion interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: The one where Cannonball plays with Miles Davis.

ctx.x: The early Cannonball, one of the early Cannonball records?
The one where Cannonball plays with Miles Davis.
Yeah. I think it’s called “A Portrait of Cannonball” or something. It’s got that “Autumn Leaves?”
